# 75322 - TTL to MOS driver

Package DIP-14 · family 753xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75322.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75322.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 44 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75322 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75322.png) | ![75322 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-75322.png) | ![75322 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-75322.png) |

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC1 | power |  | +5 V |
| 11 | VCC2 | power |  | +12 V nominal (4.75-15 V); MOS supply |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 6 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 13 | NC | nc |  |  |
| 3 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 5 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 4 | E | input |  | strobe common to both drivers |
| 12 | 1Y | output | totem-pole | MOS-level output, pulled up through the external p-n-p transistor |
| 10 | 2Y | output | totem-pole | MOS-level output |
| 1 | 1XC | analog |  | connection to the collector of the external p-n-p transistor for driver 1 |
| 2 | 1XB | analog |  | connection to the base of the external p-n-p transistor for driver 1 |
| 9 | 2XC | analog |  | collector connection of the external p-n-p for driver 2 |
| 8 | 2XB | analog |  | base connection of the external p-n-p for driver 2 |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 1Y = 1A AND E | Datasheet positive logic Y = AE. Needs an external p-n-p (TIS149, A5T4260 or A5T4261) per driver on XB/XC. |
| 10 | 2Y = 2A AND E | Same for driver 2. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputMaxVoltageV | 15 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC1 4.75-5.25 V, VCC2 4.75-15 V (nom 12), TA 0-70 C, load capacitance min 200 pF (recommended). VOH min VCC2-1.1 V at -10 mA, VCC2-0.5 at -400 uA, VCC2-0.4 at -200 uA; VOL max 0.5 V at IOL 10 mA (VCC2 11.4 V). Inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V; IIL A -1.6 mA, E -3.2 mA. Output goes to high impedance if the 5 V supply is lost (forced low with an external pull-down). outputMaxVoltageV is the VCC2 maximum. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC1 5 V, VCC2 12 V, TA 25 C, CL 300 pF, external TIS149 p-n-p.

| From | To | Edge | Min ns | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or E | Y | PLH | 12 | 27 | 38 |
| A or E | Y | PHL | 14 | 31 | 44 |
